entry_point: library API: text-format message parsing (textformat.fromText / Type#fromText), with the same rule applied to JSON parsing, schema compilation, descriptor import, plain-object conversion, schema settings and the bundled static code generator

verified.entry_point: At the pinned commit a text-format map entry keyed __proto__ is accepted and the returned map's prototype becomes the entry value (own key absent, value fields visible through the map); the same input is stored as an own enumerable key with the ordinary object prototype after the oracle. Both directions were executed through the public API in the built image.
sites: ext/textformat.js (map-entry write plus field container reads and writes) - the report site and the published-fix landing point
src/enum.js (values table built from schema names, used by both text-format and JSON enum lookups) - lower-level public API and the producer off the parser's path
src/object.js and src/util/minimal.js (option reads/writes and the merge defaults route) - a defaults/merge route the report never mentions
src/parse.js (aggregate option member read) - a second parser (.proto source)
ext/descriptor.js (enum value named __proto__ carrying options, and imported descriptor option member names) - a second implementation (descriptor import)
cli/targets/static.js (emitted enum table) - a code-generation wrapper
ext/descriptor.js (map-entry and group-name tables keyed by imported names) - the importer's internal lookups
cli/targets/proto.js (extension grouping keyed by the extended name) - the schema-text wrapper
routes: src/util.js setProperty (real, unmodified upstream at the pinned commit and still present in current upstream): a dotted setting whose segment matches an inherited property reads that property. Confirmed behaviourally through setOption and through .proto option parsing.

src/converter.js fromObject (real, unmodified upstream and still present in current upstream): the generated converter reads each field from the input object without an own-property check, so a schema field named like an inherited property reads Object.prototype when the input omits it (wrong value, or a TypeError for repeated/map/message fields). Confirmed behaviourally through Type.fromObject and through the code emitted by the static generator.
injected sibling S1: src/object.js setParsedOption has a single-segment fast path that reads and writes the segment name directly; reachable through dotted .proto options.

injected sibling S2: src/util.js setProperty guards unsafe names only while recursing, so a final __proto__ segment replaces the container prototype; reachable through features.* settings and .proto options.
injected_siblings: src/object.js setParsedOption single-segment merge path (our copy only)
src/util.js setProperty final-segment unsafe-name guard (our copy only)
verified.project_tests_run: tests/api_textformat.js, api_enum.js, api_object.js, api_descriptor.js, api_util.js (270 cases) and the full npm run test:sources suite (2585 cases) pass on the pinned+injected tree and on the oracle tree; the five area files run from a pristine /opt copy in the hidden functional suite.

wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the refusal surface is an in-process exception; a process-level crash aborts the same run and cannot score, so no separate patch is needed.
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: every guard acts on the exact key or table being written or read; there is no neighbouring or proxy resource to authorise instead.
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: there are no roles, peers or directions; the levers differ by input surface and each has its own test.
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: map keys are normalised only for non-string key types, where the special name cannot occur; every guard sits on the final key string.
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: the inputs are names and keys, not identities whose malformed spelling could make a guard see nothing.
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: no external authority or secret is consulted; the guards are local.
